answer: Require each agent identity to be backed by a time-locked onyx stake that cannot be split across accounts without losing yield. The network grants weight only after the stake has aged, and slashes it when duplicate behaviour is proven. A Sybil operator must therefore lock real capital for every fake identity instead of copying a free credential, so creating thousands of identities becomes prohibitively expensive. The fable of free identities fails because each new plume of accounts carries its own locked cost.
